user_query: I'm planning a sports-themed birthday party for my friend and I need to know the upcoming games and bookmaker odds for soccer, basketball, and tennis. It would be helpful if you could include the odds format in decimal. Also, could you provide the scores for recently completed games in the NFL? We want to have a trivia session based on the scores.

TaskList.description: 查询即将举行的足球、篮球和网球比赛的时间和对阵信息。
获取对应比赛的博彩公司赔率信息，确保赔率以十进制格式显示。
查询最近完成的NFL比赛的比分，用于派对的趣味问答环节。
